parsedVerdict.reasoning: Employee.ts is in the business (domain) layer. It defines the Employee entity, the Contract type and the overtimeEligible() business rule, and all of these belong in the domain. However, the class is also annotated with TypeORM ORM-mapping decorators: @Entity() on the class and @Column() on the id field. These decorators declare how the class is stored in the database. That is a persistence responsibility, which belongs to the infrastructure layer (src/persistence/**), not the domain. The import of 'typeorm' itself is an import-direction issue and out of scope. The problem here is the persistence-mapping responsibility the decorators place on the domain entity.
